name: znetwork_dplay_send_ex_reliable
description: zNetworkDPlay::SendExReliable forwards a packet through DirectPlay SendEx with reliable async flags and tracks the async handle.
known_limits: The smoke uses a fake DirectPlay provider for SendEx behavior; tier S verification is deferred to a zNetwork source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48ae10 validates DirectPlay SendEx slot 0xc4, reliable async flags, packet-size argument, async-handle storage, and zNetwork_DPlay::ReportError on negative HRESULT.
The native zNetwork packet-send smoke verifies reliable SendEx parameters, async handle updates, and cancellation behavior in the public wrapper path.
